scope: Treap custom-identity constructor compatibility correction after Fable review

review_findings.confirmed: A non-template S identity constructor silently changed t({7}) from a one-element sequence into an empty sequence with identity=7.
review_findings.qualified: Fable also described t({}) as a formerly valid empty construction; GCC15.2 and Clang21 probes show the saved old implementation already rejected that expression as ambiguous. The final fix retains that unsupported status and documents t{} for an empty sequence.
review_findings.additional_comparison_finding: Adding initializer_list<S> would repair t({7}) and make t({}) empty, but also changes previously valid T{{}} from an empty sequence to a one-element zero sequence. This candidate was rejected after direct compiler comparison.

final_change.constructor: template<class I> requires std::convertible_to<I,S>; explicit lazy_implicit_treap(I&& identity), forwarding into make_shared<const S>.
final_change.reason: Braced argument lists cannot deduce I, so valid legacy vector/copy/move construction forms keep their previous overload selection. Parenthesized integer values still configure identity; int-to-int64 conversion remains allowed.
final_change.documentation: Header API list and Document distinguish t(1000)/t(values,1000) from legacy braced constructions; t{} is the clear empty form.
final_change.ownership: The shared immutable identity and move/copy/swap behavior are unchanged.

validation.constructor_probe_result: 11 expressions x 2 versions x 2 compilers; all previously supported forms preserve size/elements and nonempty aggregate. The intentional default sentinel change 8e18 -> 2^60 is distinguished from constructor compatibility.
validation.runtime_cases: Default/custom identity, generic aggregate Sum values, vector+identity, scalar int conversion, copy/move and noexcept, plus all prior min/segment/clamp independent checks.
validation.related_test_scope: All existing Treap tests in native checked GCC/Clang; independent custom-inf and key exhaustive/noncommutative tests across checked/skip and native/standard fallback.
validation.instrumentation: ASan+UBSan+float-cast-overflow checked GCC/Clang native+portable; LSan additionally rerun ptrace-free. All passed.
validation.li_chao_comment_revision: The final eight custom-inf configurations include the latest Li Chao comment-only revision, whose exact SHA is recorded above.
validation.line2d_body: No further body changes; its constructor/clamp independent tests remain included.

performance: No new timing claim for this overload-only correction. Initial default API benchmark results remain tied to their earlier source snapshots in the preceding audit.
line2d_submission_correction: The separate root-owned Line2D audit covers its main now specifying 2^62 for the Library Checker answer range. This audit does not transfer old online AC to changed source.
